  • Constructor Details

    • HyperExpPar

      public HyperExpPar(double p, double lambda1, double lambda2) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      It creates a new hyperexponential parameter based on the data provided by the user. This constructor takes three parameters and creates two instances of exponential distribution which are selected with probability p provided.
      Parameters:
      p - double containing the probability to select one of the two exponential.
      lambda1 - double containing the value of lambda for the 1st exponential.
      lambda2 - double containing the value of lambda for the 2nd exponential.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException - if p is not between zero and one or if lambda1 and lambda2 are not both greater than zero.

      public void setMean(double value) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
